mute.onHint: Hide their videos from your feeds. They aren't told.
mute.offHint: Their videos can appear in your feeds again.
mute.onBody: Their videos won't appear in your feeds. You still follow them and they aren't told. You can unmute them here or in Settings > Muted accounts.
mute.offBody: Their videos can appear in your feeds again.

restrict.onHint: Their comments on your videos are only visible to them, and they can't message you.
restrict.offHint: Their comments and messages work normally again.
restrict.onBody: They aren't told. Their new comments on your videos are only visible to them, and they can't message you. You can unrestrict them here or in Settings > Restricted accounts.
restrict.offBody: Their comments on your videos will be visible to everyone again, and they can message you.

feed.followingNoPosts: People you follow haven't posted yet
